description: This file contains database helper functions for the Asset Management backend, including connection setup and query execution routines.

methods.name: str get_database_url()
methods.description: Returns the PostgreSQL database connection string, considering environment variable and default.

methods.name: _get_conn()
methods.description: Creates and returns a new psycopg connection with a dict row factory.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_all(query: str, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Executes a query and returns all resulting rows as a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_one(query: str, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Executes a query and returns a single row as a dictionary or None if no result.

ctags.name: fetch_all
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_all(query: str, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: fetch_one
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_one(query: str, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
